dev_environment: Development PC (Xeon + GTX 1070) without YuE2 or Seed-VC: stand-in runtime with FFmpeg 8.1.1 (with Rubber Band), Python 3.11 and placeholder YuE2 files; a stand-in Seed-VC inference.py with the pinned interface runs under the real seedvc_runner.py.
test_environment_note: On a Chinese-locale Windows console, run the tests with PYTHONUTF8=1; otherwise test_voice.py's self-test reads the runner's Chinese stderr as GBK and errors (an environment issue that predates v1.6.0).
checks: Catalog: the rap group is Rap, Hip-hop, Trap, Boom Bap, Melodic Rap, Drill, Emo Rap, Phonk; the four new styles have rap tags and the remix + free-melody smart default; every style is in exactly one group and reaches the engine request; 20 distinct defaults keep v1.5.0's first ten and now include Rap, Melodic Rap and Drill.
All styles: ALL_STYLES is the catalog in group order (55); version letters run A-Z, AA, AB ... (A-BC, suite parts BD-BF) and never repeat; MAX_SONG_JOBS (58) bounds the per-song seeds.

Settings: all_styles defaults to false, saves and reloads, rejects non-booleans, and a broken stored value falls back to false; per-song all_styles saves true / false / null (follow) and rejects other values.

Batch: with all_styles the server expands every catalog style (the request's own versions are ignored), one pair, distinct seeds, no speed versions, analysis reused by versions with the same source settings; smart defaults apply per style (rap styles free melody, Asian DJ keep the original singer); the suite adds three parts after the styles; an invalid switch or a full queue rejects the batch before any job is created; without the switch the 20-version limit still applies.

Voice swap: an all-styles song swaps every version only when all version switches are on (the interface's single switch), otherwise none; Asian DJ versions that keep the original singer are not swapped.
